objective: Refine the desk robot mechanical baseline into a more product-like Revision B while preserving the controlled envelope, PCB tray interface, stability gates, and explicit physical-validation boundaries.
acceptance: Revision B keeps the 280 x 240 x 330 mm envelope, 260 x 220 mm chassis, 18 mm ground clearance, 150 x 72 mm display opening, and PCB mount pattern

SCAD and the CadQuery generator describe the same product-level structure: low chassis, tapered shoulder shell, separate 8 degree head, recessed display bezel, wheel pods, corner bumpers, cable channel, and service panel
the analytical stability, tray-fit, drop-screening, and physical-validation status remain explicit and pass the existing mechanical checks
generated general-arrangement evidence names the Revision B geometry and does not claim physical validation
a product hero visual uses the Revision B silhouette and does not depict the old transparent-box geometry
mechanical package tests, artifact generation, Ruff, and Task Packet validation pass
stop_conditions: a change requires altering robot control, firmware, interfaces, or PCB ownership
a geometry change invalidates the PCB tray, stability, clearance, or impact gates
the resulting image would imply a physical prototype or test that does not exist
SolidWorks or CadQuery regeneration is unavailable; preserve the existing STEP and report the regeneration limitation rather than inventing a solid-model result
